images.prompt: A row of empty chairs against the wall of a dim corridor, facing a closed door at the end. Nobody present. Cream light pools on the floor from under the door. The single red element is a small occupancy light above the door frame. Still, patient, nothing happening. Deep dark navy dominates every surface and every background plane — never blue, never cyan, no teal anywhere. Soft cream (#F4EFE3) is the only highlight. Exactly one red element in the entire image, nothing else is red. Absolutely no text, no letterforms, no numerals, no signage, no logos, no vendor marks on any faceplate or panel. No tick-mark numerals. Full-bleed edge-to-edge artwork: no border, no cream margin, no white matting, no picture frame. Quiet, photographic, shallow depth of field.
